verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product, so performing bulk operations across many items is a category error for this kind of offering. The evidence shows only internal use of AI and automated translation. The probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec, and nothing indicates a user-facing tool with bulk actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
